queries.title: Company names or LEI codes (one per line)
queries.description: Company names are searched full-text; 20-character LEI codes are fetched directly.

country.title: Country (optional)
country.description: Two-letter code (US, DE, KE...) to limit name searches to entities legally registered in one country.

activeOnly.title: Active entities only
activeOnly.description: Skip merged, retired, and otherwise inactive entities in name searches.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per name search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many registry matches to return for each company name.

includeParents.title: Include parent companies
includeParents.description: Look up each entity's direct and ultimate parent from the ownership relationship records. Adds two API calls per entity.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on verified company rows across all queries. Controls total cost.
